document_contents.quote: the show cause notice in DRC-01 was issued on 29.11.2024, whereby, the respondent had raised 19 issues against the petitioner.

Thereafter, the impugned order came to be passed on 16.01.2025, whereby 5 additional issues were raised by the respondent, for which, no opportunity was provided to the petitioner either for filing the reply or for personal hearing.

defects_argued.quote: Hence, it is clear that in total non-application of mind, the respondent had passed the impugned order, which travels beyond the scope of show cause notice.

However, in this case, all of a sudden, the respondents had raised 5 additional issues, for the very first time, while passing the impugned assessment order, which is a clear violation of principles of natural justice.

outcome.quote: (i) The impugned order dated 16.01.2025 is set aside and the matter is remanded to the respondent for fresh consideration
